name: mirage
text: Straight answer on 'build those items': the dataset side of CLV is shipped in v1.0.34 (consensus, sources and confirmed columns, API-quality journal). What is left is changing the Kotlin grader to keep every close for each bet instead of the first, and the same join for bids. That touches the grader and the phone's bet record and needs the full test run, so I have written it into TASKS as the next engine item (CH57) instead of rushing it here. It's next in line.
